summary: v5.0 massive update tested end-to-end. 20/20 backend tests pass after one cached-subs filter fix. All 7 frontend surfaces (/sec, /trade-floor, /tf-engine, /lottery, /performance, /contracts, sidebar) render correctly. Two issues found and fixed (cached non-public subs leaking through contracts; TRADE FLOOR missing from sidebar nav). One open observation: Dashboard cards may not visually show Trade Score side-by-side with AXIOM (needs main-agent confirmation — see action_items).

minor.issue: subaward_cache stored pre-v5.0 entries with non-tickered subs; cache hit path was returning them unfiltered. Fixed by also filtering cache reads to ticker-only subs in usaspending.py _enrich.

ui_bugs.issue: TRADE FLOOR nav item used group 'TRADE FLOOR' but the render loop only iterated ['CORE','v3.2','ANALYSIS','SYSTEM'] → /trade-floor link never rendered. FIXED by adding 'TRADE FLOOR' to the group list.
React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' — missing key={} on mapped rows in both pages.
Recharts warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1)' on chart containers — ResponsiveContainer without explicit minWidth/minHeight when tab hidden. Cosmetic.

issues: Could not visually confirm TRADE score is rendered side-by-side with AXIOM score on every card. AXIOM 27.6/36.5/etc visible; no explicit TRADE: NN label observed. Main agent should verify Dashboard.jsx ~line 408 renders both scores when trade_score>0 (or shows '—' when missing) with green/red/amber coloring.

action_items: Verify Dashboard.jsx ~line 408 actually renders TRADE score next to AXIOM score on every card (color: green higher, red lower, amber equal). I could not confirm it is visible in the current Dashboard render — main agent self-check recommended.
Add unique key={} props to SECPage and ContractsPage row maps (eliminates React key warning).
Optionally clear/migrate subaward_cache collection in MongoDB so cached pre-v5.0 entries with non-public subs are purged (current fix filters on read; one-time backfill would be cleaner).
critical_code_review_comments: usaspending.py:638 — cache reads bypassed the v5.0 public-subs filter; only the live-fetch path filtered. Now patched.
CrtShell.jsx NAV group list is a hardcoded array; any new group label silently drops items. Consider deriving groups from NAV: [...new Set(NAV.map(n=>n.group))] to avoid future regressions.

/api/trade_floor/regime first call after backend cold start returned status='unknown' with spy_last=None — subsequent calls returned green. Pricer chain may be lazy-initialised on first hit; consider warming Alpaca/SPY pricer on startup or add fallback in /regime to retry once on None.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all pages render, sidebar nav fixed; Dashboard TRADE-vs-AXIOM side-by-side rendering needs confirmation)

seed_data_creation: None. SEC /api/sec/poll inserted live EDGAR filings (~39 in 7d window). Trade Floor manual_send was exercised with AAPL@$50 risk; returned ok=false (gates), no real order side-effects beyond Alpaca paper account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_v8_api.py covers: Trade Floor (account/regime/engine status/recalibrate/positions/manual_send), SEC poll+list (ticker required), Contracts public-only sub_awards, Alpaca in price source priority, and 10-endpoint legacy regression. All 20/20 pass. UI verified: /sec renders 39 filings with 5 stat tiles (FILINGS/NARRATIVE/ACTIVIST/8-K/FORM 4); /trade-floor renders 5 tiles + 5 tabs (Risk Dashboard shows RISK ON/VIX/SPY/positions); /tf-engine renders PRE-ADJUSTMENT phase + 13 inherited weights + 'populates after first 5 closed trades' message; /lottery has 15 lottery-send-tf-{TICKER} buttons; /performance has perf-active + perf-closed testids; sidebar now correctly shows SEC FILINGS, TRADE FLOOR, TRADE ENGINE entries. Remaining open: confirm Dashboard.jsx renders TRADE score side-by-side with AXIOM. Activist 13D count was 0 today (Genco SC 13D was non-activist) — expected per spec.
rca of the issue: Bug 1 — Sidebar missing TRADE FLOOR: CrtShell.jsx line 287 hardcoded a group iteration list ['CORE','v3.2','ANALYSIS','SYSTEM'] but the TRADE FLOOR nav row in NAV[] used group='TRADE FLOOR', which was filtered out → no sidebar link to /trade-floor. Repro: GET / → inspect sidebar → no TRADE FLOOR entry. Fix: added 'TRADE FLOOR' to the iterated groups (verified via re-render: nav now contains TRADE FLOOR). Bug 2 — Contracts cached subs not filtered: usaspending.py _enrich() cache-hit path at line 634 returned cached.sub_awards directly without applying the v5.0 public-subs filter, so historical cache entries surfaced 339/1420 non-tickered subs. Repro: GET /api/contracts?days=180&min_amount=100000000 → enumerate sub_awards → 339 lacked ticker. Fix: filter cached subs to s.get('ticker') truthy on read; verified — full backend suite passes 20/20.
